title: Sign encoding of a function
statement: For a function $f:(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n\to\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$, define its sign encoding to be the function from $(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$ to the multiplicative group of units of the integers that sends each $x$ to the sign encoding of $f(x)$.
